# VozClinic

> VozClinic provides production-grade bilingual AI receptionists ("Sofía") for medical, dental, aesthetic, and healthcare clinics across Mexico and cross-border regions (Tijuana, Mexicali, Los Algodones, Ciudad Juárez). It answers patient inquiries 24/7 on WhatsApp and phone calls in fluent Spanish and natural English, qualifies insurance, books directly into practice management systems (PMS), and hands off emergencies to clinical staff.

## Overview

- **Product Category**: Bilingual AI Receptionist / Voice Agent for Healthcare & Clinics
- **Primary AI Persona**: Sofía
- **Headquarters**: Tijuana, Baja California, Mexico
- **Company**: The LNL Agency LLC, d/b/a LNL Automations by LNL AI Agency LLC
- **Languages**: Native Spanish and fluent American English (trained and tested with cross-border patients from San Diego, Los Angeles, and Phoenix; switches dynamically mid-conversation)
- **Compliance**: Mexican Federal Data Protection Law (LFPDPPP). Patient data is stored and processed under Mexican privacy regulations; data is never used to train public LLM models.

## Core Capabilities

1. **24/7 Omnichannel Reception**:
   - **WhatsApp**: Handles patient text, voice notes, and location maps with official WhatsApp Business API (no per-message surcharge).
   - **Phone Calls**: Inbound and outbound voice agent that speaks natural English and Spanish with human cadence and low latency.
   - **Escalation**: Automatically detects emergencies, complaints, and complex medical questions to transfer immediately to the clinic's designated human line.

2. **Scheduling & Calendar Integration**:
   - Live two-way synchronization with practice management software (PMS) and calendars (Open Dental, Google Calendar, and any PMS with an available API).
   - Resolves conflicts in real time, offers available time slots, and reconfirms reschedules instantly.

3. **Insurance Intake & Cross-Border Logistics**:
   - Collects insurance card photos (front & back), policy ID, group numbers, and patient details for US PPO and dental insurance pre-qualification.
   - Provides accurate Tijuana / San Ysidro / Otay border crossing directions, Fast Pass instructions, parking guidance, and payment policies.

4. **Patient Recall & Reactivation**:
   - Automatically reminds patients due for cleanings, adjustments, or annual checkups.
   - Reactivates dormant patient lists with personalized 1:1 outreach over WhatsApp.

5. **Reporting & Transparency**:
   - Daily morning digest of all patient interactions in the previous 24 hours.
   - Weekly WhatsApp summary report detailing total conversations, appointments booked, and escalated cases.

## Monthly Pricing & Plans (USD)

All plans are month-to-month with no long-term contracts. Setup takes approximately 90 minutes.

- **Esencial ($299 USD/mo)**:
  - 1 doctor, 1 location.
  - Up to 600 conversations/month.
  - Full WhatsApp & phone call coverage, calendar sync, bilingual English/Spanish.
- **Profesional ($599 USD/mo - Most Popular)**:
  - 2 to 4 doctors, 1 location.
  - Up to 1,500 conversations/month.
  - Full reception, scheduling, insurance collection, and weekly reporting.
- **Pro Claims ($1,499 USD/mo)**:
  - Multi-doctor clinics with high patient volume.
  - Up to 4,000 conversations/month.
  - Integrated US insurance verification, automated claim paperwork, and priority onboarding.
- **White-label ($4,999 USD/mo)**:
  - For healthcare marketing agencies and large hospital / clinic groups.
  - Custom branding, dedicated infrastructure, and multi-clinic management.

## Channels & Add-ons

- **Included in Every Plan**:
  - WhatsApp Business API 24/7 reception.
  - Inbound and outbound phone calls.
  - Daily morning digest and weekly WhatsApp activity report.
  - Urgent-case escalation line transfers.
  - PMS and calendar integration (any PMS with an available API).
- **Optional Add-ons**:
  - Website voice and chat widget.
  - Slack and Telegram team channels.
  - SMS text messages (carries US A2P 10DLC carrier registration and sending volume fees).
  - Outbound WhatsApp marketing campaigns and seasonal promotions.

## Target Specialties & Locations

- **Specialties**: Dental clinics (implantology, orthodontics, cosmetic dentistry), plastic & cosmetic surgery, bariatric surgery, fertility clinics, medical spas & dermatology, ophthalmology, and orthopedic surgery.
- **Primary Markets**: Tijuana (Zona Río, Playas de Tijuana), Mexicali, Los Algodones, Ensenada, Rosarito, Ciudad Juárez, and Mexican medical tourism hubs serving patients from California, Arizona, and Nevada.
